activities.title: Beginner Tennis Practice at the Clubhouse Courts
activities.instructions: Take junior tennis racquets and low-compression tennis balls to your clubhouse courts. Begin with a simple warm-up by having your child balance a ball on the strings of their racquet while walking along the court lines. Next, stand a short distance away and gently toss the ball underhand, encouraging them to track the ball with their eyes, let it bounce once, and tap it back across to you. Keep the rallies relaxed and focus on hand-eye contact and timing.

activities.instructions: Head to Maple Community Arts Center for a focused, bite-sized creative session.
